en-US.title: MileMint: Mileage Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Log Every Mile, Cut Your Taxes
en-US.promoText: You drive for work, so those miles are money. MileMint logs every drive automatically and adds up your IRS deduction as you go. No spreadsheets, no guesswork.
en-US.description:
You drive for work. Every one of those miles is money off your tax bill: 76¢ a mile at the IRS standard mileage rate from July 2026 (72.5¢ before that). Drive 10,000 business miles and that's a deduction of more than $7,000.

The catch? You need a record of every trip, and almost nobody keeps one. MileMint keeps it for you.

Just drive. MileMint logs each trip automatically, helps you sort business from personal with a swipe, and adds it to your running deduction total. By tax time, your miles are already counted.

WHY DRIVERS CHOOSE MILEMINT
• Free for your first 40 automatic drives every month, with unlimited manual trips and a free export of your log
• No account to create, no ads, and we never sell your data
• Your location history stays on your iPhone, encrypted. We never see it.

AUTOMATIC TRIP LOGGING
• Detects drives on its own and records start, end, route and distance
• Treats a quick stop (a pickup, a coffee, a red light) as part of the same trip, so one drive stays one trip
• Easy on your battery: low-power geofencing while you're parked, GPS only while you're driving
• Missed one? Add a trip by hand in seconds

SORTS YOUR TRIPS FOR YOU
• Swipe right for business, left for personal, or select a batch of trips and sort them in one go
• Set your work hours once and drives inside them are marked business automatically
• Name your places ("Home", "Main Office", "Storage Unit") so your log reads like a proper record
• Learns your regular routes: classify the same drive the same way twice and MileMint does it for you from then on
• Commute warning: flags home-to-work drives, which the IRS doesn't let you deduct
• Optional weekly reminder to sort the week's drives

SEE WHAT YOU'RE SAVING
• A running deductions total that grows with every business drive
• Each unsorted drive shows what it's worth if it was for business
• Uses the IRS standard mileage rate, including 2026's mid-year change

RECORDS YOU CAN STAND BEHIND
• Captures what the IRS asks for: date, where you started and ended, miles and business purpose
• Every trip is time-stamped as it happens, and every edit is kept in a history, so your log shows it was kept as you went
• Export your full mileage log as a spreadsheet (CSV) any time, free
• Add your odometer readings for the year
• Encrypted with AES-256 on your iPhone, with the key held in your iPhone's Keychain

MILEMINT PRO
• Unlimited automatic drives. Drives over the free limit are kept, never lost, and unlock when you upgrade.
• An IRS-ready PDF report: your Schedule C vehicle mileage, the deduction at each IRS rate and the full trip log, ready for your accountant
• $5.99 a month or $49.99 a year, with a 30-day free trial on the yearly plan
Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

MADE FOR
Rideshare and delivery drivers, real estate agents, contractors and trades, home health and field workers, sales reps, and anyone who claims or gets reimbursed for mileage.

MileMint estimates deductions using the IRS standard mileage rate. It isn't tax advice; check with a tax professional for your situation.

MileMint uses your location in the background to detect drives. You can switch to manual logging at any time.

Just drive. MileMint logs each journey automatically, lets you sort business from personal with a swipe, and keeps a running total of your claim for the tax year. By the time your Self Assessment is due, your miles are already counted.

Just drive. MileMint logs each trip automatically, lets you sort business from personal with a swipe, and keeps your kilometres organized by tax year. When it's time to file, your logbook is already done.

The catch? The ATO can ask how you worked out your kilometres, and almost nobody keeps a record. MileMint keeps it for you.

Just drive. MileMint logs each trip automatically, lets you sort business from personal with a swipe, and keeps a running total of your claim for the income year. At tax time, your kilometres are already counted.
